The air in the ancient library was thick with the scent of old paper and hidden desire. 📚✨ As a professor from Italy, I am used to being the center of attention, but today the heat was rising in a way that had nothing to do with the weather. I adjusted my silk blouse, feeling the fabric stretch slightly over my chest as I leaned over the dusty archives. My tailored pencil skirt hugged my hips perfectly, accentuating my curves while keeping a dignified, yet undeniably sexy silhouette. Suddenly, the door creaked open. It was Marco, the handsome archivist we’d been exchanging charged glances with for weeks. His eyes dropped to my lips, then lower, appreciating the way my outfit clung to my body. 'I found it,' he whispered, his voice low and husky, holding up a rare manuscript. But it wasn't just the book that made my heart race; it was the intensity of his gaze, the promise of a secret affair among the stacks. I smiled, biting my lip, and walked toward him, the sound of our heels clicking on the stone floor like a countdown. 🇮🇹💋
